intro: For more than four decades, Newgate 180 has been Ontario’s premier non-profit treatment centre for drug and alcohol addiction. During this time, the organization has helped over 5,000 individuals successfully resolve their addictions and rediscover hope for a better tomorrow. With experienced, certified staff and evidence-based techniques, Newgate 180 is an excellent choice for anyone looking for a personalized and effective approach to overcoming addiction.

Whether you’re struggling with alcohol, cocaine, opioids, benzodiazepine, or any other addictive substance or behavior, Newgate 180 can help. Our personalized one-year treatment program, which includes 30-day residential treatment followed by eleven months of ongoing care, is designed to maximize your chances of a successful recovery.
Hope is only a click away, so reach out to us today.

pillars.title: Newgate 180: How We Can Help You Overcome Addiction
pillars.body: If you’ve been struggling with addiction, reaching out for help can be the hardest thing you’ll ever do. But at Newgate 180, we want you to know that there’s hope, and we’re here to provide it. We offer a range of treatment programs that can be tailored to your unique needs and goals, from gender-specific programming to evidence-based techniques like cognitive-behavioral therapy (CBT). What sets Newgate 180 apart from other drug and alcohol rehab centres is our one-year treatment program, which includes both 30-day residential treatment and ongoing care for the next eleven months. We believe that addiction is a complex and chronic disease that requires ongoing support and care to fully overcome, which is why we’re committed to making sure that our clients receive the help they need not only to recover but to thrive. If you’re ready to take the first step towards a better future, contact us today.

pillars.title: Newgate 180: Addictions We Treat
pillars.body: At Newgate 180, we’re proud to offer specialized care for a range of addictions, including: alcohol, amphetamine, benzodiazepine, cocaine, gambling, hallucinogen, marijuana and opioids. We understand that addiction is a complex and multifaceted disease, which is why we take a personalized approach to treatment that considers your unique history, needs, and goals. Whether you’re struggling with addiction to one of the substances listed above or something else entirely, we can help. Contact us today to learn more about how we can support your recovery journey.

pillars.title: A Historic Home on the Rideau River
pillars.body: Newgate 180 is a large three-storey historic home on the banks of the Rideau River, at the edge of Merrickville village. Bedrooms are private or semi-private and sit on two residential floors, and men and women are housed separately. The main floor has big living and dining rooms and a professional kitchen. Downstairs you'll find a group room, an exercise room and laundry. Outside of program hours, people canoe, kayak or fish right behind the house, sit by the fire pit, or take a walk into the village.

overview: Newgate 180 is a top-rated rehabilitation center located in the serene and tranquil environment of Merrickville, Ontario. The center specializes in treating addiction and mental health-related disorders, providing cutting-edge treatment solutions that are custom-tailored to each patient’s individual needs. The facility offers a comprehensive range of therapies and treatments designed to help individuals overcome substance abuse and mental health disorders, and lead fulfilling and healthy lives.

At Newgate 180, the focus is on the patient’s overall well-being, which is why the center offers several holistic therapies such as yoga, meditation, art and nature therapy, to complement evidence-based practices in individual and group therapy, counseling, and nutritional counseling. The center’s family services program provides support for family members and loved ones, so they can better understand addiction and mental health disorders and provide meaningful support during and after a patient’s treatment. With top-notch facilities, expert staff, and cutting-edge treatment programs, Newgate 180 is the go-to destination for anyone seeking the most effective and comprehensive addiction and mental health treatment services.

Regardless of the nature of a patient’s addiction or mental health issue, Newgate 180 is well-equipped to support individuals through the healing process, providing a path to a better, healthier life.

location.heading: Newgate 180 in Merrickville, Ontario
location.intro: Newgate 180 is at 435 Main Street East in Merrickville, a heritage village on the Rideau River in Leeds and Grenville, about 30 to 45 minutes south of Ottawa by Highway 416 and roughly 15 minutes from Smiths Falls. Brockville and Kemptville are both within 40 minutes, Kingston is about an hour and a half away, and the drive from Toronto takes around three and a half hours on the 401.

faqIntro: Answers come from the centre's listing and its own website. Still unsure? Call, it's free and confidential.

faqs.a: The full program costs $20,000 CAD, paid once on admission. That covers the 30-day residential stay and the 11 months of continuing care after it, including family sessions, meals and a medical assessment. Newgate 180 is a registered charity, so there's no HST and nothing extra to pay later.

The program lasts one year. You live at the centre in Merrickville for the first 30 days, then move into 11 months of continuing care with weekly counselling, in person or online. In residence, programming runs six days a week and Sundays are kept for reflection, family visits and one-to-one sessions.

Not as a separate detox program. You need 72 hours of sobriety to start, and anyone with significant withdrawal is referred to a nearby detox centre first. Some clients can stabilize on site instead, under the Medical Director, Dr. Bhaskar Gopalan, and move straight into treatment; when he decides it's safe, that's included in the fee.

faqs.q: How soon can I be admitted?
faqs.a: Usually within 24 hours, because Newgate 180 has no waitlist. You start with a short screening with a counsellor, generally by phone, and do a full intake assessment when you arrive. Admissions usually answers calls from 8 am to 9 pm, seven days a week.

faqs.q: Where is the centre and how do I get there?
faqs.a: Newgate 180 is at 435 Main Street East (Highway 43) in Merrickville, Ontario. From Ottawa, take Highway 416 south to Exit 34 at Kemptville and follow Highway 43 west into the village. From Toronto or Montreal, take the 401 to Prescott and then the 416 north to the same exit. The centre can help you arrange transportation, including from the Ottawa airport.

You move into 11 months of continuing care at no extra cost. Each week you meet the Continuing Care Counsellor who helped you write your Recovery Plan, and your family keeps coming to the Sunday sessions. If you relapse or come close, your care team can bring you back into residence for a free one-week stabilization stay.

faqs.q: Is this a private centre? Can I use my benefits?
faqs.a: Yes. Newgate 180 is a private, not-for-profit centre and a registered charity. Some insurance plans cover the program, so check with your provider, and admissions will also work with your employer, union or referring agency. Financing through ifinance is available, with terms from 12 to 84 months.

faqs.q: What kind of addiction treatment does Newgate 180 offer?
faqs.a: Newgate 180 offers a personalized one-year treatment program that includes 30-day residential treatment followed by eleven months of ongoing care. Our evidence-based techniques include cognitive-behavioral therapy (CBT), among others.

faqs.q: How many people has Newgate 180 helped over the years?
faqs.a: Newgate 180 has helped over 5,000 individuals successfully recover from addiction and live full, happy lives.

faqs.q: Can I receive immediate assistance if I contact Newgate 180?
faqs.a: Yes, Newgate 180 offers immediate assistance to those in need.

faqs.q: What makes Newgate 180 unique compared to other rehab centres?
faqs.a: Newgate 180’s personalized one-year treatment program, which includes both residential treatment and ongoing care, sets us apart from other rehab centres.
